selection_policy: Use pre-October training windows to screen the full SPY momentum grid and expanded 120-minute STI mean-reversion grid without a per-window trading eligibility threshold. Select the final pair by the highest after-cost September joint validation return under the requested sizing method. Never use October data or overwrite a selected-strategy file automatically.

joint_diagnostic_period.role: Pre-October validation used to select the final shortlisted SPY/STI pair.

sizing_comparison_period.role: Pre-October rolling-window sizing diagnostic using the training-ranked SPY and STI candidates.
